<!-- Generated by src/CommaTs/docs/site/scripts/convert-guide.mjs from src/CommaTs/docs/PluginGuide.html. Do not edit. -->

-   **Plugins** live in Tekla under *Applications & Components* (Ctrl+F), under the **Comma** group, in the sub-groups **General** (Rebar Class Decoder, License, Export Import), **Model Edit**, **Rebar** and **Drawing**. The main ones also have a button on a dedicated **Comma** ribbon tab (Modeling and Drawing modes each have one) — no need to open the catalog every time. On the Modeling tab the **General** tools (Rebar Class Decoder, License, Export Import) come first, then the **Model Edit** tools in a two-row block and the **Rebar** tools (Rebar Inspector, and the rebar Model Edit tools once they ship) in a two-row block after it.
-   **Macros** live in the same catalog, under **Comma > Macros** — split into *Modeling* and *Drawing* tabs depending on which mode you're in. Macros are catalog-only, not on the ribbon.
-   Every plugin dialog shows a licence status in the top-right corner (Licensed / License expired / Trial days remaining / Trial expired). If it reads *License expired*, paste your renewed key into uCommaLicenseManager and click Activate.
